user.title: Drinking water quality
user.description: Choose your region. Data comes from the French health authorities' sanitary checks (orobnat.sante.gouv.fr).

reseau.title: Distribution network
reseau.description: Several networks supply {commune}. Choose the one serving your address (see your water bill or ask your town hall).

abort.already_configured: This town and network are already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: Cannot reach orobnat.sante.gouv.fr. Try again later.
abort.no_reseau: No distribution network is published for this town.

init.title: Samples from my town
init.description: A network often serves several towns, and samples are taken in each in turn: the latest report may come from a neighbouring town (same water). Tick to go back through older reports to the latest sample taken in {commune} (at most 20 reports and 2 years; otherwise, the network's latest report).
